description.paragraph1: Ecomcodehub is the must-have solution for Shopify merchants looking to transform their store into a highly converting shop. Thanks to optimized and customizable TailwindCSS and Liquid codes, you can boost your conversions, provide a smooth user experience, and give your store a look worthy of the best themes without spending hundreds of euros.
description.paragraph2: Designed by a fullstack developer, SEO consultant, and web designer with over 7 years of Shopify store creation experience, Ecomcodehub follows web standards and guarantees optimal SEO performance.
description.paragraph3: Join our dedicated Discord server, included with all packs, even one-time purchases, to ask your technical questions, share feedback, discover new features first, and co-build the next Ecomcodehub snippets with the community.
description.paragraph4: Shopify design and store audits will also be regularly proposed to identify improvement points. These audits will be exclusively reserved for subscribers.
description.paragraph5: Ecomcodehub's goal is to bring together an ambitious community of merchants and succeed together.

items: 1. Choose your pack: Select a credit pack based on your needs: Beginner Pack (20 credits), Advanced Pack (60 credits), or Pro Pack (90 credits).

2. Payment and login: Once your payment is validated by Stripe, your credits will be automatically added. You will then be invited to log in using the email address used at checkout. You will have to confirm your email to access your account.

3. Explore available codes: Once logged in, follow the instructions on the "installation" page to configure your Shopify theme, then explore the codes sorted by complexity level (1, 3, or 5 credits). Each code is designed to enhance a specific feature of your Shopify store.
4. Unlock a code: Depending on the number of credits you have, you can unlock basic codes (1 credit), intermediate (3 credits), or advanced (5 credits).
5. Add a code to your Shopify store:
Log in to your Shopify dashboard.
Go to "Customize theme."
Click on "Add section," then select "Custom Liquid."
6. Paste the code: Copy the unlocked code and paste it directly into the "Custom Liquid" section of your Shopify theme.
7. Save and admire: Click "Save," then instantly see the changes applied to your store.
Easy to use: No technical skills needed ;), just copy, paste, and you're ready!
Affordable: A cost-effective alternative to expensive Shopify themes (up to 350€).
SEO optimized: Lightweight and efficient code to improve your store's visibility.
Compatible with all Shopify themes: Works perfectly regardless of your current design.
I am available to support you at every step, whether it is a technical issue or a question about installing or using the codes.
Contact me directly: Via Discord or by email: ecomcodehub.team@gmail.com
Can I get a refund? Yes, a refund is possible only if no credit has been used. Once a snippet is unlocked, the purchase is considered consumed.
How to request a refund? Just contact me by email with the address used for the purchase: ecomcodehub.team@gmail.com
Support at your service: Before any refund, I am here to help you resolve your technical issue. My goal is your satisfaction.
100% Secure Payment: All transactions are protected via Stripe and its official partners including Apple Pay, Google Pay, Revolut, PayPal, Amazon Pay, Link, and Twint.
Accepted Payment Methods: Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Revolut, Link, PayPal, Twint, Bancontact, Amazon Pay.
Certification and Compliance: Stripe is PCI DSS Level 1 certified, the highest security standard for online payments.

1.title: What are Shopify liquid codes, and how do they work?
1.content: Shopify liquid codes are snippets of customizable code designed to enhance your Shopify store's functionality. With our pre-built codes, you can easily add features like custom product filters, dynamic pricing displays, or unique design elements—all without advanced coding knowledge.

2.title: Do I need coding experience to use these?
2.content: Absolutely not. If you can copy and paste, you can use these snippets. Most merchants install their first snippet in under 5 minutes.

3.title: Will these work with my Shopify theme?
3.content: Yes. Our snippets are built with Shopify's native Liquid language and tested across 200+ themes including Dawn, Impulse, Prestige, Debut, and custom themes. If you encounter any compatibility issue, our support team will help you fix it.

4.title: What happens if I encounter any problems?
4.content: We've got you covered! If you encounter any problems, just send me a message at ecomcodehub.team@gmail.com and I'll help you fix it.
